chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, when a believer calls upon Allah, the Exalted and Mighty, He answers him.
I stared at him in amazement at this.
He said: Indeed, Allah is Bountiful (Wide) to His creatures.

key_terms.إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَاسِعٌ: Allah is Bountiful/Wide (in provision and response)

ai.seo_question: Why does Allah answer the prayers of believers so readily?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) highlights the immediate responsiveness of Allah to the supplications of believers, a concept rooted in the divine attribute of *Wasi'* (All-Encompassing). The narrator's awe at this promptness serves as a reminder that God's capacity to answer is not limited by time or space, reflecting His boundless generosity towards all creation. This narration underscores the Shia theological emphasis on the accessibility of the Divine through sincere du'a, supported by the Quranic assurance that Allah is near and responsive.
